office: # Events of the central offices that their websites post in a way the daily import cannot read (pictures on a page, a card or paragraph whose date cannot be read, a flyer on a home page), typed in by hand from the office's own site. They are shown with the imported ones on /calendar/central-offices/ and in the Events calendar's Central offices filter — never on the Area's Google Calendar. One row per event; a row whose last day is over disappears by itself (it can stay or be deleted).

# office = the key in data/central-offices.csv. id = a short name for the row (a-z, 0-9, -), kept when the title is corrected, so the event keeps its address (co-<office>-manual-<id>). title / title_es = as the office writes it (no full names: first name + last initial at most). date = the first day (yyyy-mm-dd); end_date = the last day of a multi-day event; start_time / end_time = 19:00 or 7:00 PM (no start_time = all day; an end before the start = the next day).

# venue, address (street), city, zip = the place. format = In person, Hybrid or Virtual (never type a Zoom ID, link or passcode anywhere). language = English, Spanish or Bilingual (empty = the office's language). type = YPAA, Convention, Forum, History, Workshop, Social or Event (empty = guessed from the title). cost = as printed. summary = optional, a sentence or two (no names, phones, e-mail addresses or sobriety dates).

# flyers = the addresses of the flyer pictures (or PDFs) ON THE OFFICE'S OWN WEBSITE, separated by spaces: the site links them where they are, after the flyer check (data/office-flyer-review.csv) passed for each file. src = the office's page where the event is listed. checked = the day someone last saw it there. notes = for editors only (never shown). The import (scripts/office-events.mjs) reads this table every day and whenever it changes; a row whose event an office's own listing already carries (that office's or another's) is left out and reported in the import's summary: then delete it. Two rows for one event (two offices) make one card. An office whose adapter is none in data/office-event-sources.csv is never asked for anything: its rows' flyers are not downloaded or shown.

title: District 6 Holiday Party & Meeting
summary: District 6's holiday party and December district meeting. Mexican food and entertainment are provided; bring a favorite holiday sweet treat to share. Volunteers are welcome for setup and cleanup.
notes: From OC Intergroup's November 2026 Lifeline (newsletter PDF): Upcoming Events (p. 15) and the district's flyer picture (p. 9). Not on oc-aa.org's events calendar. The flyer is only inside the newsletter PDF, so no flyer address.

title: All South Bay Central Office New Year's Eve Party
summary: The central office's New Year's Eve party: dinner and dessert, DJ, karaoke, photo booth, raffle and a 9 PM balloon drop. Tickets at the door and at the central office in Torrance; proceeds support the central office.
notes: Pop-up flyer on asbco.org's home page (picture and its full-size PDF). Not in ASBCO's events calendar, which lists only its service meetings. ZIP not printed on the flyer.

title: Bingo at Unity Hall
summary: TVCO Intergroup invites everyone to Bingo at Unity Hall, to help the Temecula Valley Central Office carry the message. Candy and ink blotters are for sale.
notes: The office's page says Saturday, January 9, 2026 (a typo: that was a Friday; January 9, 2027 is a Saturday, and the flyer was uploaded Nov 17, 2026), so the import read it as past. Delete this row if the office corrects the year (the import's summary will say so).

title: 63rd International Women's Conference
summary: International conference where women in A.A. gather to share the language of the heart, in Buffalo and online.
notes: Text block on the Special Events page (its picture is hot-linked from a mail service, not the office's site). Days and venue from the conference's own site (internationalwomensconference.org). Also on OIAA's Group Events page (next row).

title: 63rd International Women's Conference
